lastCompletedStory.title: Re-frame Cross-Repo PRD docs as agent-self-executed (unvalidated)

nextStoryContext: US-001 was a docs-truth-up only: no src/ consumer was added for crossRepoLayout/repo. All four doc copies (scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md, templates/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md, .claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md, templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md) now say cross-repo routing is agent-self-executed and unvalidated, with a CAM-241 pointer for future real harness support. Remember: .claude/ and templates/ copies of CLAUDE.md are NOT byte-identical (templates/ is a generic placeholder-based template for cam init consumers) — diff before assuming a shared edit applies to both.
